name: Smoke Dungeon
accessNote: Requires partial Desert Treasure I access and face protection from smoke effects and Dust devils. The task-only western multicombat area is guarded by Dusty Aliv and is good for bursting or barraging, but cannot use a dwarf multicannon; the remaining single-way rooms can be cannoned. Wearing a Slayer helmet here for a Dust devil kill is required for the Hard Desert Diary.
